pvp.$comment: New-player protection: Keep 1-2 fight AI only; at Keep 3 real-player battles are optional (opt in); from Keep 4 they are standard.

rating.$comment: Hidden combat rating P = 0.35 D + 0.30 O + 0.20 H + 0.15 S, each input normalised to 0..1000: D and O against a full village and army at the top Keep, H by Keep level, S by recent battle results.

population.$comment: Share of opponents that are real players, by eligible human villages in the attacker's band, then capped by defender capacity: f = min(1, D x C / A).
population.$ratingBand: Real candidates whose stored combat rating P is within ratingBand of the attacker's come first (broad progression band); fairness of offense vs defense orders them after that.

shadowRank.$comment: Elo on expected performance, from battles against real players only. Generated opponents never change it. Seasons last seasonDays; ratings are pulled halfway back to start at each reset.

tournament.$comment: Normalized tournaments: everyone gets the same warrior levels and housing; only the army you pick and how you fight matter. Practice battles: no warriors are spent and nothing is lost. Rewards pay once per tournament per threshold and are never sold.
tournament.name: Shadow Tournament

catchUp.$comment: When new Keep levels launch above launchTopHall, every upgrade that belongs to a Keep level at least levelsBehindTop below the new top gets faster and cheaper, so newcomers can catch up.

allianceBoard.$comment: Alliance (player clan) ranking over the last `weeks` Alliance Wars: points per win against a real Alliance, per win against an AI clan war band, per draw, plus points per region settlement its members hold.

warfare.$comment: Clan war format by the number of human members; war size is flexible so small clans are never shut out. Formats in aiOnly fight an AI clan war band (cooperative AI raids); the others meet Alliances of the same format, or an AI war band when none is free.

regions.$comment: Online, each player joins a regional world instance; a new one opens when the newest is full.

factionLeadership.$comment: Human leadership of an AI faction: the most active contributor among recently active members leads; inactive leaders lose the seat; nobody leads more than maxTerms seasons in a row.

health.$comment: Targets for the internal health view (illustrative early-testing goals).
